title: How much do you think like a cryptanalyst?

questions.question: You're reading a book and a character says something you don't understand. You:
answers: immediately try to figure out what it's hinting at
must have missed something earlier, or it's written confusingly
figure it's something that hasn't been explained yet and keep reading

questions.question: Your friend asks you what you think of their project. You generally like it, but you see some potential problems. You:
answers: just say nice things—you're their friend, it's your job to support them, not criticize them
give them the feedback—it doesn't help them make it better if you don't tell them how it could improve
